title: Inter should rest Calhanoglu at Venezia
caption:
Inter are at Venezia today with top spot to protect, and the case for resting Hakan Calhanoglu is the derby three days later. Sky Sport Italia has Aleksandar Stankovic starting in midfield and Calhanoglu rested, per Sky Sport Italia via FCInterNews (Oct 27) — reported, not official. Confirmed: Inter lead Serie A on 22 points from eight, level with Lazio on goal difference.
